icons_library_instruction: Use lucide-react (or lucide-react-native if using Expo). Default to slim stroke-width (1.5) for a premium, non-bulky aesthetic.
instructions_to_main_agent: Environment Mapping: If the environment forces React web, you MUST structure it as a Mobile-First PWA (max-w-md, mx-auto, hide standard web nav, use bottom tab bar). If Expo/React Native is allowed and configured, use NativeWind with these exact Tailwind classes.
Do not use Inter for headings. Use Outfit (or a similar modern geometric sans if unavailable, like Cabinet Grotesk or Satoshi).
Never use full-screen flat colors. Add subtle noise/grain or the provided Unsplash abstract texture at 10-20% opacity behind the main surface.
Bento Grid / Cards: Use pure #0B101F with a sharp 1px border (#1E293B or slate-800). No soft muddy box-shadows. Shadows should be hard and dark if used.
Accessibility/Contrast: Ensure text on the dark background uses text-white or text-slate-300. Never use text-slate-600 on a slate-900 background.
Interactive Elements: All buttons and navigation must have active/pressed scaling states (`active:scale-95`).
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid (e.g., data-testid='agent-chat-button').
